title: Provincial Palace
geometryBasis: Native OSM building outline, measured terrain, the dated Filipe Fidanza plate, and published government documentation of the restored building.
sectionBasis: The long masonry frontage is two main storeys above an exposed ventilated plinth, with tall rounded windows, cream pilaster and cornice bands, a central balcony, and roof behind a parapet. The historic side and rear returns descend toward Avenida Floriano Peixoto.
limitations: The main historic exterior and connected wings follow the measured outline. The heights, less visible rear openings and rooftop details are estimated. Current exterior colours follow the government description.
